source_caption:
📺 New Amsterdam (2018–2023)

New Amsterdam follows Dr. Max Goodwin, a brilliant and compassionate physician who becomes the medical director of one of America’s oldest public hospitals in New York City. Determined to transform a struggling healthcare system, Max challenges outdated rules, hospital bureaucracy, and financial obstacles while putting patients’ needs above everything else. Alongside a dedicated team of doctors and nurses, he faces life-threatening emergencies, complicated medical cases, and emotional personal struggles. As Max works to improve healthcare for underserved communities, he must also balance his demanding career with family responsibilities and unexpected challenges. Combining powerful medical stories, emotional moments, and inspiring acts of compassion, the series explores leadership, sacrifice, friendship, and the importance of making healthcare accessible to everyone.

🎭 Genre: Medical Drama • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 8.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~43 minutes per episode • 5 seasons • 89 episodes

🎥 Creator: David Schulner

🏆 Recognition: Starring Ryan Eggold, Freema Agyeman, Janet Montgomery, Jocko Sims, and Tyler Labine, the series was inspired by Dr. Eric Manheimer’s memoir Twelve Patients: Life and Death at Bellevue Hospital and gained praise for its emotional storytelling and focus on healthcare reform.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Netflix, Peacock, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or digital purchase availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: New Amsterdam is an American medical drama television series, based on the book Twelve Patients: Life and Death at Bellevue Hospital by Eric Manheimer. The series aired on NBC from September 25, 2018, to January 17, 2023, with 89 episodes over five seasons. The series was created by David Schulner and stars Ryan Eggold, Freema Agyeman, Janet Montgomery, Jocko Sims, Anupam Kher, Tyler Labine, and Sandra Mae Frank.
